name: native immediate draworder command
lua_assertions:
for _, order in ipairs({90, -45, -12.9, 180/2}) do
 local self=native_sprite
 self:finishtweening():z(7):zoom(1):diffusealpha(1):linear(0.22)
 local duration=self:GetTweenTimeLeft()
 assert(math.abs(duration-0.22)<0.000001)
 assert(self:draworder(order)==self, "draworder returns self")
 assert(self:GetTweenTimeLeft()==duration, "draworder does not interrupt pending tween")
 assert(self:GetZ()==7, "draworder is independent of render depth")
 self:diffusealpha(0):draworder(90)
 assert(self:GetTweenTimeLeft()==duration, "later draworder keeps queued duration")
end
native_sprite:finishtweening():sleep(0.1):draworder(90):diffusealpha(0)
assert(math.abs(native_sprite:GetTweenTimeLeft()-0.1)<0.000001, "draworder preserves sleep")
